The {{lcfirst:{{PAGENAME}}}} is where you'll bury [[corpse]]s.  All you must do to designate an area as a grave place is select it as an option at the [[graveyard]] blueprint desk.  Digging out a grave will use durability on your shovel.  Each grave can take two decorations, one grave fence and one grave marker and each decoration will effect the {{Graveyard Rating}} of the graveyard as a whole. 

The number of positive modifiers to {{Graveyard Rating}} a grave can benefit from is based on the number of {{Skull|Red}} and {{Skull|White}} on the [[corpse]] buried there.  A grave's positive score cannot exceed the number of {{Skull|white}}, any modifiers added beyond that point will have no effect. Modifiers can be gained through decorations but also from the [[corpse]]s themselves, attempting to remove a {{Skull|red}} when none are available will cause a [[corpse]] to gain an intrinsic +1{{Graveyard Rating}}.   For more information on corpse rating see [[corpse]] and for more information on preparing corpses see the [[morgue]] location page.
